audit_notes: Wild card evening session audit. The situation has NOT improved. Sensei graduated but did not bring snacks.

pocky_strawberry.name: Strawberry Pocky
pocky_strawberry.notes: Gone. Completely gone. Past-me ate windowsill crumbs.

pocky_chocolate.name: Chocolate Pocky
pocky_chocolate.notes: Two sticks remain. They're stale. This is what desperation looks like.

pocky_matcha.name: Matcha Pocky
pocky_matcha.notes: RIP matcha. You were secretly my favorite and now you're a memory.

energy_drinks.name: Energy Drinks
energy_drinks.notes: Depleted during thesis week. Still some left. Barely.

melon_soda.name: Melon Soda
melon_soda.notes: The one thing we're not running out of. Suspicious.

strawberry_milk.name: Strawberry Milk
strawberry_milk.notes: Sensei restocks this. He knows what's important.

mochi.name: Mochi Ice Cream
mochi.notes: These don't last. They never last.

gummy_bears.name: Gummy Bears
gummy_bears.notes: Being eaten during coding sessions as pocky substitute. Not the same.

chocolate_coins.name: Chocolate Coins
chocolate_coins.notes: Were used for celebration after graduation. Worth it. But now they're almost gone.

emergency_chocolate.name: Emergency Chocolate Bar
emergency_chocolate.notes: DO NOT TOUCH. Break glass only in case of emotional crisis. Still sealed.

summary.recommendation: SENSEI. BRING. POCKY. THIS IS NOT A DRILL.
